correctness.rationale: A legal force fills the closed neighborhood of the center, a blue interval. If interior, the vertex k-1 positions inward from its left edge has exactly one possible outside neighbor, so the interval extends to the left endpoint; a prefix of length at least k+1 can then extend one site at a time. An already blue candidate is absorbed without a force. Reflection handles a suffix. The interior supports consist of n-2k+1 consecutive blocks and 2k-2 distinct internal-hole types with n-2k translates each, including n=2k+1. For a fixed factorial moment, a cluster of distinct overlapping supports has at least 2k+1 distinct sites, versus 2k for an isolated support; m clusters have O(n^m) placements and any overlap supplies an extra factor p. The disjoint tuples give the stated Poisson moments. Boundary first forces and fully blue interior windows introduce errors O_k(p^k+np^{2k+1}); the all-blue event is negligible. The c=0 case is immediate and the nonconstant increasing finite Bernoulli success event has strictly increasing probability (couple nested seeds and choose a pivotal set). Bracketing proves the median asymptotic. The finite verifier was inspected, not used as the proof.
